title: Target anatomy
view: Transverse section of the right thigh about 6 cm above the crease, patient prone, skin at the top: lateral (biceps femoris) on the image right, medial on the left - as the positioning plate.
teachingPoint: Tibial and common peroneal nerves side by side in one paraneural sheath; needle in-plane from lateral, tip inside the sheath between the nerves, outside both; the popliteal vessels are medial and deep.
claims: Prone right thigh in section, lateral on the right (matches the positioning plate; NYSORA's prone figure, concept only).
Tibial nerve medial, common peroneal lateral, in one common paraneural sheath (record).
Popliteal vein deep and medial to the tibial nerve, the artery deepest (record).
Needle in-plane from lateral, tip in the sheath between the nerves, outside both (record).
Teal: spread filling the sheath around both nerves (record).
Labels: Tibial nerve, Common peroneal nerve, Popliteal vein, Popliteal artery, Biceps femoris.
